name: (💼 INTERACTIVE JOB) Young Street, Ontario Beta
desc:
✨ Next code at 110000 Likes! (New codes will be added next update)
✨ Current Active Codes: "80KLIKES" & "90KLIKES"

🌍 Welcome to Young Street, Ontario, also known as YSO! Inspired by the real Yonge Street in Ontario, Canada, YSO is a detailed driving and role-playing game where you can explore the map, drive and customize vehicles, work different jobs, drift, race and much more!

⭐ Join our Community Group!: https://www.roblox.com/communities/17376821/Young-Street-Ontario

⚙️ If you're on PC, press F while in the vehicle to start it. Use E and Q to switch between Drive, Neutral, and Reverse.

⚠️ This game is still in early development and is not complete; some features are missing. Stay tuned for more updates soon!

⚠️ Having trouble? Join our community server and send us the details. We'll do our best to help.
